name: obts
description: Obsidian True Sync deployable history, restore, diagnostics, and maintenance implementation.

scripts.build: npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:plugin && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/package-shared-client.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build:plugin:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build --config frontend/dashboard/vite.config.ts --mode check
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:plugin:check && vitest run && npm run test:formal
scripts.test:formal: node scripts/check-formal-model.mjs && node scripts/check-bridge-bounded-model.mjs && node scripts/check-bridge-bounded-model.mjs --worker-companion && node scripts/check-deletion-model.mjs && node scripts/check-bridge-external-protocol.mjs && node scripts/check-onboarding-model.mjs
scripts.test:bridge:stack: npm run build && cargo build -p obts_bridge && node scripts/check-bridge-stack.mjs
scripts.test:upgrade-compat: npm run build && node scripts/check-server-upgrade.mjs && npx vitest run tests/transfer-readiness-observational.test.ts
